active_control.name: current_v31_control
active_control.selector: mass-only qblock_max: max over the 128-row block of the row's prefix log-share z - logsumexp(z), top MAGE_K/64 tiles per (query head, 128-row block); canvas/boundary tiles always kept and not charged
active_control.source_of_truth: results/v32_value_aware_20261007/SOURCE_NOTE.md and a real record of results/v31_20261006_aime_global_local

runtime.gpu: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, CUDA device 0, one worker at a time

seeds.dev_subset: 20261007 (only for reserving the development subset; never for selecting a variant by outcome)

status: PARTIAL: selectors implemented, qualified and smoke-tested; the accuracy/timing panels are BLOCKED by a host GPU fault (see README.md)
study: value-direction-aware block selectors inside the v31 cross-step reuse pipeline

study_configuration.consumer: unchanged v27_fa4.sparse_lists over the same [1, H, QB, KT] bool map
study_configuration.mandatory_tiles: canvas/boundary tiles j >= prefix/64, plus sink/recent protection (both 0 in this configuration)
study_configuration.observation_output: unchanged: FA4's own native current-step BF16 output at the initial/refresh call

projection.bank: the repository's frozen Projections().get, once per (layer, native KV head), never regenerated per step/canvas/variant
projection.matrix_sha256: recorded per native KV head in every record's value_projection.records

study_configuration.quota: identical for every arm: reserve k = MAGE_K/64 optional slots, apply the frozen threshold while optional slots remain, force skip when none remain, force keep when all remaining are needed, force keep the first valid support; boundary ties are kept (>=) and the greedy argmin takes the lowest tile index
study_configuration.reference_scale_nu: inherited valid-KV reference: sqrt(sum_u ||v_u||^2 / count_valid) per native KV head, clamped at 1e-12, broadcast from the KV head
study_configuration.row_aggregation: max over the valid rows of the 128-row map block (the control's qblock_max aggregation, unchanged and not tuned per method)

selector_kernel.v1: triton_value_scan (fused; must equal the batched reference exactly)
selector_kernel.v2: triton_value_scan (fused; must equal the batched reference exactly)
selector_kernel.v3a: batched reference, one full-support summary pass
selector_kernel.v3b: batched reference, exact backward greedy, BLOCKED above value_exact_max optional tiles
selector_kernel.v3b_shortlist: batched reference, V3a-ranked shortlist then the exact greedy on it

statistics.mu: one observation-only Triton pass: v27_consumer64.fused_observe OUT=0 MU=1 mu_precision=tf32x3 splits=1 (no V load, no PV, no output partials)
statistics.reduction: FlashAttention-style tile max + log-sum-exp; no unbounded exponential and no full token attention matrix is ever materialised
statistics.tail: the FP32 canvas/boundary logits the control already forms, reduced to tile statistics
statistics.z: the SAME FA4 in-kernel observation as the control (v31_fa4_observe.observe_dense)
